systems.owner: ONPRA (Office National de Protection des Réfugiés et des Apatrides, under the interior ministry), with UNHCR
systems.tiers: ONPRA registration staff, at the Cishemere and Makombe transit centres since February 2024; reception at ONPRA headquarters in Bujumbura

systems.country_label: système BIMS (fingerprint and iris identification of asylum seekers)
systems.tiers: ONPRA registration staff, at enrolment of asylum seekers after pre-screening by the Commissariat Général des Migrations

note: Asylum procedure page: the systems are refugee registration and biometric enrolment run by the refugee office, not station records. The police appear only as referring asylum seekers and issuing an attestation of loss for a lost document, with no system described.
